blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Health (DOH) recorded 10,936 cases of leptospirosis as of Sept. 16, a 38% increase from the 7,931 cases reported during the same period last year. Of the cumulative cases, 7,242, or 66%, were associated with floodwater exposure amid continued rains, according to the DOH. From Aug. 20 to Sept. 2, the country recorded 3,805 cases, 116% higher than the number recorded in the previous two weeks. The increase pushed the number of cases past the epidemic threshold.
